name: Case 3 · The Workshop
blurb: Portside, heavy rain. Three specialists. One hidden workshop. The Act 1 finale.

lines.text: Juno hijacks the precinct's main projector live. The whole squad stops to watch. She just proved INTERCEPT's network leaks.
"I installed your Sightline update this morning. Patched three backdoor exploits while I was in there. You're welcome."
"Third victim. Port dispatcher, Tobi Lawal. Snatched on the night shift. Same red kite left on his desk. Get moving."

scenes.title: They planted a decoy. Read past it.
scenes.sentence: The hostages are at ___ because of ___ and ___.

scenes.brief: [EYE DRONE ACTIVE] Juno's drone confirms visual. Target 'Spool' is moving between the shipping yard and the workshop.

scenes.win_text: A shipping container slams down into your lane. You drift beneath it, sparks flying. Spool bails out on foot into the stacks.

scenes.prompt: Three hostages chained to workbenches. The server wipe progress bar just hit 96%.

left.label: Save all three hostages
left.result: Bolt cutters snap the chains. The hostages stumble out just as the server finishes wiping. Dead end.
left.echo: The Keys are lost. You will have to rebuild the plan from the city itself.

right.label: Grab the drive
right.result: You yank the drive at 99%. Outside, a crane lifts Funmi's container away. You saved the data, but lost her again.
right.echo: You hold part of the Keys. Funmi is recovered at the start of Case 4.

hesitate.label: You hesitated
hesitate.result: Sol shoulders past you and tackles the hostage locks. The drive finishes wiping. Both of them noticed you froze.
hesitate.echo: Both of them noticed who decided.

scenes.win_text: The gantry remote shatters in his hand. Spool drops to his knees on the catwalk, rain washing the blood away.
scenes.lose_text: A 10-ton container slams down between you, shattering the catwalk. You still bag him, but half the port is destroyed.

scenes.title: Act 1 · The Kites
scenes.text: The rescued victims sit in holding, shivering in foil blankets. "They made us build... The Keys. A backdoor into traffic control. The bridge schematics. The port's blind spots."
scenes.cliff: Spool leans against the interrogation glass. "I never saw the client. We got paid in maps. The Cartographer says hello, Rook."
scenes.cta: End of Act I skeleton — Act II is next
